caption: Conditional economics of the proposed four-event chronology device under three constructed scenarios. Light-purple bars show mean operating profit during twelve production months after assumed physical qualification; dark-purple bars show q times that operating mean less the central originating development cost of $141,792.30. The central development pathway assumes nine months and no AI engineering-hour saving; the low/high development-duration alternatives are three/eighteen months. Qualification probabilities q = 0.25, 0.50 and 0.75 are uncalibrated assumptions. The fixed policies are evaluated on 512 confirmation worlds per scenario. Project values are probability-weighted expectations, not the sampled project-profit mean or annualized returns. Labels show the frozen numerical means and expectations to the nearest cent; that display precision does not establish empirical accuracy. Customer value, demand, physical success and cost adequacy remain unvalidated. Actual collections are zero and the actual decision remains HOLD.
alt: Paired horizontal bars compare conservative, central and favorable scenarios. Conditional annual operating means are minus $73,910.25, plus $20,979.00 and plus $417,868.10. Expected project results after central development cost are minus $160,269.86, minus $131,302.80 and plus $171,608.78. All are constructed scenarios.
qualification_probability_source: Uncalibrated constructed scenario assumptions, not finite-model pass rates.
